original_test_intent: Program the approved SR-IOV enable state and VF capacity for the exact BlueField PF, activate it through the required power cycle and verify persistent configuration plus expected PF/VF topology.
original_method: Map serial/BDF/MST device/PF and management role; query/save current mlxconfig, BIOS/IOMMU and PF/VF topology; validate supported VF capacity/resources; approve persistent SRIOV_EN/NUM_OF_VFS delta; apply/read back; power-cycle under OOB; verify mlxconfig, sriov_totalvfs/numvfs, lspci and ip link; rollback on mismatch.
manual_activity: Network/platform owner approves exact PF, persistent enable/count and BIOS/IOMMU state; operator controls power and recovery; agent may apply only the approved delta and collect topology evidence.
required_inputs: Supported SRIOV_EN and NUM_OF_VFS values plus resource limits
BIOS SR-IOV/IOMMU state and driver compatibility
Current mlxconfig/PF/VF topology backup and rollback
Maintenance drain, alternate OOB/console and power-cycle plan
safety_requirements: Distinguish persistent mlxconfig from runtime sriov_numvfs
Never guess PF or VF count
Maintain alternate access and capacity headroom
Stop on resource, topology, driver, management or recovery anomaly; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Query and apply exact persistent mlxconfig delta
Collect readback and full post-cycle PF/VF evidence
Do not substitute runtime-only write or retry blindly

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Writing sysfs sriov_numvfs changes runtime enumeration but does not prove the source SRIOV_EN/NUM_OF_VFS NVRAM transaction; sshpass and hard-coded 4 are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Query/save exact mlxconfig prestate, apply only approved SRIOV_EN/NUM_OF_VFS to the mapped device, read back, power-cycle, then collect full mlxconfig/lspci/ip link/sysfs topology.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Persistent SR-IOV enable/VF count, power-cycle query and 20-minute allocations are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat SR-IOV as a versioned topology transaction with capacity validation, persistent/readback proof, cold activation and deterministic rollback.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, runtime-versus-persistent separation, resource checks, OOB/recovery and complete topology evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Runtime VF creation cannot substitute for persistent mlxconfig and post-power-cycle verification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: VF enumeration consumes resources and can disrupt PF networking or management; BIOS/IOMMU/driver limits may cap the count.

project_override_considerations: Owner must specify persistent versus runtime objective, exact VF count per PF, BIOS/IOMMU prerequisites, expected VF identities and whether VFs should be instantiated immediately after boot.
expected_evidence: Target PF/device map and supported capacity
Pre/post mlxconfig query and exact write output
Management health, logs, rollback if used and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master writes persistent SR-IOV NVRAM with mlxconfig and verifies after a power cycle; DeepSeek substitutes a runtime sysfs VF instantiation, which has different persistence and coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if PF identity, supported count, persistent scope, BIOS/IOMMU, prestate/rollback, OOB/power or post-cycle topology cannot be established.

review_improvement: Separates two non-equivalent SR-IOV mechanisms and requires the persistent configuration, activation and topology evidence the source actually specifies.
independent_technical_reasoning: sriov_numvfs instantiates VFs for the current driver session, while mlxconfig changes firmware/NVRAM capacity or enablement that survives reboot. A correct review cannot exchange them: it must prove the intended persistence layer and then verify the exact PF/VF enumeration after activation.
